datasets.name: 5527b4d6
queryLines:
-- prev_quarter_t28d_avg is needed by calc field qoq_change_pct_all -> compute it here.
WITH filtered AS (
  SELECT deployable_account_name, fiscal_year, fiscal_year_quarter, snapshot_date, dbu_dollars_t28d_avg
  FROM main.field_forecasting_tool.agg_okr_qoq_growth
  WHERE horizontal_and_vertical_hierarchy_concatenated_emails LIKE CONCAT('%', :ae_email, '%')
    AND Business_Unit = :business_unit
    AND sales_subregion_level_1 = :region_level_1
    AND sales_subregion_level_2 = :region_level_2
)
SELECT
  deployable_account_name, fiscal_year, fiscal_year_quarter, snapshot_date,
  ROUND(dbu_dollars_t28d_avg, 2) AS dbu_dollars_t28d_avg,
  ROUND(LAG(dbu_dollars_t28d_avg) OVER (PARTITION BY deployable_account_name ORDER BY snapshot_date), 2) AS prev_quarter_t28d_avg,
  ROUND(dbu_dollars_t28d_avg - LAG(dbu_dollars_t28d_avg) OVER (PARTITION BY deployable_account_name ORDER BY snapshot_date), 2) AS qoq_change,
  TRY_DIVIDE(
    dbu_dollars_t28d_avg - LAG(dbu_dollars_t28d_avg) OVER (PARTITION BY deployable_account_name ORDER BY snapshot_date),
    LAG(dbu_dollars_t28d_avg) OVER (PARTITION BY deployable_account_name ORDER BY snapshot_date)
  ) AS qoq_change_pct
FROM filtered

datasets.name: a3f7b2c9
queryLines:
WITH is_manager AS (
    (SELECT 1 AS flag
     FROM main.gtm_gold.rpt_individual_hierarchy_active_valid_sales_user_only
     WHERE Email != current_user()
       AND ARRAY_CONTAINS(SPLIT(concatenated_emails, ','), current_user())
     LIMIT 1)
    UNION ALL
    (SELECT 1 AS flag
     FROM main.gtm_silver.individual_hierarchy_field
     WHERE email != current_user()
       AND ARRAY_CONTAINS(SPLIT(concatenated_emails, ','), current_user())
     LIMIT 1)
  ),
  viewable_users AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT user_email, user_name, Business_Unit, Region_Level_1, Region_Level_2
    FROM (
      SELECT DISTINCT Email AS user_email, user_name, Business_Unit, Region_Level_1, Region_Level_2
      FROM main.gtm_gold.rpt_individual_hierarchy_active_valid_sales_user_only
      WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM is_manager)
      UNION
      SELECT DISTINCT Email AS user_email, user_name, Business_Unit, Region_Level_1, Region_Level_2
      FROM main.gtm_gold.rpt_individual_hierarchy_active_valid_sales_user_only
      WHERE Email = current_user() AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM is_manager)
      UNION
      SELECT DISTINCT ti.Email AS user_email, ti.user_name, ti.Business_Unit, ti.Region_Level_1, ti.Region_Level_2
      FROM main.gtm_gold.account_active_users_daily a
      INNER JOIN main.gtm_silver.individual_hierarchy_field fe
        ON fe.email = current_user()
        AND ARRAY_CONTAINS(SPLIT(a.sa_only_concatenated_emails, ','), fe.email)
      INNER JOIN main.gtm_silver.targets_individual ti
        ON ti.sfdc_user_id = a.account_executive_user_id
      WHERE a.account_executive_user_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM is_manager)
    ) t
    ORDER BY user_name
  )
SELECT user_email, Business_Unit, Region_Level_1, Region_Level_2 FROM viewable_users
WHERE Business_Unit = :business_unit
  AND Region_Level_1 = :subregion_level_1
  AND region_level_2 = :subregion_level_2
